name: Mediastack
tagline: Real-time and historical news headlines API for global media coverage
description: Mediastack is a REST API for live and historical news headlines from thousands of sources worldwide. It supports filtering by keyword, country, language, category, source, and date, with JSON responses suited to news apps, aggregators, and research tools.

auth.details: API key via access_key query parameter; self-serve signup at mediastack.com

pricing.free_tier_limits: 100 requests/month free (Free plan); HTTP only on free tier
pricing.paid_plans: Standard from ~$24.99/mo (10k req), Professional ~$99.99/mo (50k), Business ~$249.99/mo (250k); higher tiers available

rate_limits: Monthly request quotas by plan; per-minute limits not clearly published on pricing page

example.response_snippet: {"pagination":{"limit":10,"offset":0,"count":10,"total":100},"data":[{"author":"Example Author","title":"Sample tech headline","description":"Brief summary of the article.","url":"https://example.com/article","source":"example-news","image":null,"category":"technology","language":"en","country":"us","published_at":"2026-08-01T12:00:00+00:00"}]}

use_cases: fetch latest headlines by keyword or topic
filter news by country, language, or category
build a news aggregator or media monitoring feed
pull historical news for a date range
